newsitem.title: UK: Elton John pleads with Britons - stick to safe sex.
newsitem.headline: Elton John pleads with Britons - stick to safe sex.

text.p: Pop star Elton John, donating 100,000 pounds ($167,900) to a new AIDS "clinic of hope", pleaded with Britons on Friday to stick to safe sex and not be complacent.

John, whose AIDS foundation has now raised more than seven million pounds ($11.7 million) for 100 projects around the world, said: "There is no cure for Aids and there is a danger that people believe there is a cure."
"People must maintain standards of safe sex," said the singer as he gave funds to a new London clinic. "I'm making this donation on behalf of all the people in work in the trenches."

Speaking to reporters at Ealing Hospital in west London, he said: "I have known people who have told me how great it is in this hospital and I have known people who have died here. I think it is probably the finest in Europe."
